description: EPL insert-into from-pattern parity replaying all four EPLInsertIntoFromPattern executions with one fresh runtime per case: pattern-wildcard-props replays EPLInsertIntoPropsWildcard, an insert-into with an explicit column list (es0id, es1id) selecting the tag properties es0.id/es1.id from pattern [every (es0=SupportBean_S0 or es1=SupportBean_S1)] into MyThirdStream, observed through the s0 select-* listener; pattern-explicit-props replays EPLInsertIntoProps, an insert-into with an explicit column list (s0, s1) selecting the tagged events themselves into MySecondStream, observed through the s0 listener selecting s0.id as es0id, s1.id as es1id; pattern-no-props replays EPLInsertIntoNoProps, an insert-into without a column list selecting the tagged events into MyStream (default tag-named columns), observed through the s0 listener over MyStream#length(10); pattern-named-window replays EPLInsertIntoFromPatternNamedWindow, a PositionW named window with win:time(1 hour).std:unique(intPrimitive) retention fed from SupportBean and an s1 insert-into selecting * from pattern[every a = PositionW -> every b = PositionW], observed through the s1 listener on the insert-into statement itself. The first three cases send SupportBean_S1{id:10,p10:""} then SupportBean_S0{id:20,p00:""} and observe the absent OR-branch tag projecting null; the named-window case sends SupportBean{theString:E1,intPrimitive:1} then SupportBean{theString:E2,intPrimitive:1} and observes exactly one listener row carrying the a/b tagged events projected to {theString,intPrimitive}.
